parsed.why: Strong administrative gender-marker and name-change regime, hate-crime penalties, and a supportive state. Held down by prison placement by birth sex with a documented rape, a stalled conversion-therapy bill, and a historic visa instruction.

Thin dossier. No criminalisation or trans-specific offence, but no anti-discrimination law, a tolerate-or-ignore posture, and online retribution. No documented trans visitor exposure, so the score sits near the middle on structural signals.

Enforced criminal ban on same-sex conduct with mass arrests, de facto prohibition of being transgender and of gender-affirming care, no gender-marker route, and documented killings with police complicity and impunity.

Civilian same-sex conduct legal, but military criminalisation and discharge of a trans soldier. Health ministry refused trans hospitalisation guidance, no anti-discrimination law, and survey-measured discrimination. Positive court rulings and LGR available.

Pioneering self-declaration law, X markers on IDs, and public health access, with courts reversing the minors care ban. Reduced by the 2025 prison-housing decree, a deteriorating climate, aggregated hate-crime counts, and a gender-motivated killing aggravator no longer applied.
